title: docs(pm-dispatch): the batch #62 skill folds — file-surface batch independence, priority in the selection order, the readings-ledger ceiling exception, the suite-event head re-read, the director carve-out
body:
Fixes #16386
Fixes #15803
Fixes #16352
Fixes #16372
Fixes #16343
Refs #15647

Five governed cards of decision batch #62 (plus one rider from batch #65), folded into one rules-only PR on `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`. Every line pin is unchanged — `SKILL.md` 811/811, `references/core-rules.md` 150/150, `references/seat-post-protocol.md` 91/91 — and every added line is paid by a same-file fold that deletes a superseded, dead or duplicated line (never a re-wrap of two distinct rules). No issue numbers or comment ids in the corpus text; the rulings are cited here.

Rulings executed (quoted, not paraphrased — the maintainer's word on every batch #62 item is 「同意」):

- #16386 乙 — comment 5563909225: "an increment to `platform-readings.md` raises the ceiling to the landed line count without a per-increment decision card, **provided** the seat's acceptance comment on the PR shows: every candidate fact verified by the seat, deduplicated against the ledger (candidates / landed / already-present / declined counts), one line per fact, no re-wrapping counted as currency. The raise is recorded in `ruledRaises` citing this standing ruling. Every other file's ratchet keeps the human floor unchanged."
- #15803 §A option (c) — comment 5563910163: "Two cards in one batch are independent when their declared file surfaces are disjoint, regardless of package. The four disciplines that were the maintainer-exemption clause become the standing rule … Same-file work stays strictly serial. Family dispatch … needs no rule change. … Cross-file semantic coupling is caught by the merge queue's CI — say so in the text".
- #16352 — the card's rule to land: 「取卡全序:`priority:p0` 插队 > `pm:blocking` > `target:` 板上项 > `priority:p1` > `p2` > `p3` > 无级;同级内 type `Bug` 先,再按卡龄。」 (no separate grading comment carries an order; the body's "rule to land" is the ruled text).
- #16372 — the card: "before trusting any suite or check event, re-read the PR object and take the head from it; a check reading is bound to that head, never to the event's SHA."
- #16343 — grading comment 5560156370, option A: "one carve-out sentence in SKILL.md 〈入口与角色〉 naming the director seat exempt from readings one and two and the 自退 rule, the generic mutex untouched for `domain:*` seats; seat-post-protocol.md gains a status-word form for a multi-summon seat …, and the ratchet map's comment quoting the old authorization sentence is refreshed."
- #15647 §2 item 1 (rider) — comment 5564445539, batch #65: "**Quote, never paraphrase.** A dispatch brief carries a card's precise claim verbatim … → SKILL.md, dispatch-brief rules." Item 2 of that ruling lands in `platform-readings.md` with #16457, so this PR only `Refs` that card.

## Folds, per card (old line → new line → the fold that paid)

Line numbers are `origin/main` at `245c6a23cd` (the flight's base).

### 1 · #16386 乙 — the human-floor exception (`SKILL.md`)

Added after 391 (the third human-floor line):

```text
- 唯一例外:`platform-readings.md` 增量抬上限到落地行数,免决策卡,记 `ruledRaises` 引常设裁决。
- 条件:席位验收评论逐条核实、去重计数(候选/落地/已有/拒收)、一事一行、不计重排。
```

"Every other file's floor is unchanged" is carried by 唯一例外 (the one exception) rather than by a third line. `platform-readings.md` is the bare spelling SKILL.md already uses at 621.

Paid by two deletions:
- 551 `- \`premise_still_valid: false\` + 无 PR 是合法且常常有价值的交付。` — a duplicate of 776 (报告契约: `- \`premise_still_valid: false\` + \`pr: null\` 是合法终报,当再分诊输入复核,永不当失败派发。`), which is the fuller statement; 597 keeps the dev-corrects-PM half.
- 75 + 76 (`- 分诊席跑普通直连会话、默认判断档。` / `- 代裁与契约复审等达档职责改派显式传 \`model\` 的契约复审档子代理。`) → one line `- 分诊席跑普通直连会话、默认判断档;达档职责改派显式传 \`model\` 的契约复审档子代理。` — one rule, exactly as core-rules.md line 18 already digests the pair into one line.

`core-rules.md` line 97 (the digest's 「门禁削弱」 category) is left as is: the exception is a one-file 细则 and the digest's category still holds; no ≤120-byte spelling of 97 fits the exception, and the ruling scopes the write to "SKILL.md's human-floor row". Flagged in the report as an open question for the seat.

### 2 · #15803 §A (c) — batch independence by file surface (`SKILL.md`, `core-rules.md`)

- 434 `- 并行度以 \`batch\` 封顶,同批按构造文件面不相交;\`priority:p0\` 插队可超 \`batch\`。` → `- 并行度以 \`batch\` 封顶;同批独立性按文件面不相交判,⛔ 不按包;\`priority:p0\` 可超 \`batch\`。`
- 435 `- 批次独立性:一批内任两单不得可能碰同一个包/registry/barrel/spec schema;拿不准就串行。` → **deleted** (the package criterion is superseded by 434; 「拿不准就串行」 moves to the ① discipline line).
- 444 `- 维护者明示豁免同文件串行时,替代纪律四条:① 文件面申报到区域级。` → `- 并行纪律四条(常规,非豁免):① 认领申报文件面到区域级,拿不准就串行。` (445, the ②③④ line, unchanged).
- 446 `- 豁免不外溢。` → dead under the ruling (the exemption IS the rule); its line carries the CI sentence: `- 文件面不相交只保证文本可合并;跨文件语义耦合由队列 CI 逮住,⛔ 不读作不可能冲突。`
- 478 `- 文件面对跨域例外单必填、普通单建议;分支名必须带 issue 号。` → `- 文件面申报到区域级,每单必填;分支名必须带 issue 号。`
- core-rules 106 `- 一批内任两单不得碰同一个包、注册表、barrel 或 spec schema;同文件的单跨轮硬串行。` → `- 同批独立性按文件面不相交判,⛔ 不按包;同文件硬串行,冲突交合并队列仲裁 ⛔ 不手排。` (the two merge-`main` steps stay in SKILL.md 445; the digest carries the criterion, the serial rule and the arbiter).
- 216 (linked / same-parent cards never share a batch), 259–262 (the cross-domain path already reads file surfaces) and 439 (the family-fold gate 「同包/区域」) state no package criterion and stay; family dispatch stays a recommendation.

Net: +1 (CI sentence) −1 (435) in SKILL.md; core-rules in place.

### 3 · #16352 — priority in the selection order (`SKILL.md`, `core-rules.md`)

- 454 `- 取卡全序:\`priority:p0\` 插队 > \`pm:blocking\` > \`target:\` 板上项 > type \`Bug\` > 其余;同级按卡龄。` → `- 取卡全序:\`priority:p0\` > \`pm:blocking\` > \`target:\` 板上项 > p1 > p2 > p3 > 无级;同级先 \`Bug\` 再卡龄。` (119 bytes; the ruled sentence verbatim is 153 bytes, so 插队 — already stated at 434 and in the state table's `priority:p0` row — and the word `type` are the only drops).
- 456 `- 全序每级取既有信号现读/现算,零逐卡维护;优先是排序不是豁免。` → `… ;无级卡轮报记分诊缺口。` (the card's "ungraded is named in the round report as a triage gap"; 120 bytes exactly).
- core-rules 109 `- 取卡全序:插队卡、有下游依赖者的卡、发版板上项、缺陷卡、其余,同级按卡龄。` → `- 取卡全序:插队卡、有下游依赖者的卡、板上项、p1、p2、p3、无级;同级缺陷卡先再卡龄。`

Line-neutral, no fold needed. `references/dispatch-runbook.md` line 7 (the level rationale, which names p0 / blocking / bug / age and states no order) is outside this flight's declared file surface and is untouched — noted in the report.

### 4 · #16372 — re-read the PR head before trusting a suite event (`SKILL.md`)

Added after 659 (the subscription line in 入队与落地):

```text
- 信任 suite/check 事件前先重读 PR 对象取 head:检查读数绑定该 head,⛔ 不绑事件带的 SHA。
```

Paid by folding 656 + 657 (`- 合并后工作流不在任何 PR 的检查清单上,读 PR 检查的规则对它全盲。` / `- 该类仓的部署工作流按独立检查类登记,与 PR 检查分开读。`) — one fact and its own restatement — into `- 合并后工作流不在 PR 检查清单上,读 PR 检查的规则对它全盲;按独立检查类登记分开读。`

### 5 · #16343 — the director carve-out (`SKILL.md`, `core-rules.md`, `seat-post-protocol.md`, ratchet map comment)

- SKILL.md, added after 84 in 〈入口与角色〉: `- 总监席多场并行、无在任者:读数一、二与自退对它不成立;\`domain:*\` 席互斥照旧。` — paid by the 75+76 fold above (the four SKILL.md inserts are paid by 435, 551, 75+76 and 656+657 as a set; 446 is in-place).
- core-rules 20 `- 未收班活动任一未满一个轮次即自退;有收班简报可直接坐席,坐席后先写开轮标记。` → `- 未收班活动任一未满一轮即自退,总监席除外;有收班简报即坐席,坐席后先写开轮标记。` (the digest of the same rule, changed in step per SKILL.md 优先级 line 44).
- seat-post-protocol.md: added after 12 `- 多场席(总监):\`🟢\` 后写召唤账号,状态块逐场一行(会话 ID + 锚);无在任者、无接管。` — paid by folding 8 + 10 (`- 标题即状态板,固定格式 …` / `- \`label:pm:seat\` 的列表页因此就是全舰队状态板。`) into `- 标题即状态板,固定格式 \`[PM seat] <座位名> — <状态>\`;\`label:pm:seat\` 列表页即舰队状态板。`
  The status-word form deliberately reuses the existing `🟢 〈github-login〉` word with the summoning account, rather than adding a fifth word: `check-half-states` H5 reads any `🟢 WORD` as a login that must be an assignee (only `Routine` is special-cased) and reports any other glyph as `unrecognized status word`, so a new word would create a phantom H5 finding on the director post; and the live post (#12708, `🟢 os-zhuang(第 15 场 …)`) already carries exactly this form with the per-summon detail in the body. Line 9's vocabulary and line 38's 「标题词表不扩」 therefore stay as written. (Angle brackets are spelled full-width 〈〉 in this body; the file uses ASCII.)
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` director row comment: it claimed the charter file carried the 2026-08-27 authorization sentence "verbatim in the file" and called the seat "owning the contract-review chain"; the charter now carries the ruling as a rule line (`授权面 = 人工定期召唤 …`) and holds the after-audit, not the chain. The comment keeps the maintainer's quotation, says the file carries it as a rule line, and names the four duties and the concurrent-summons shape. Comment only; no ceiling moves.
- The card's "eight lane files" reading lived only in the ratchet's self-test roster label, which PR #16437 replaced with a directory-derived roster (landed as `32e57e5abe`, merged into this branch); no map comment says "eight", so nothing else to refresh.

### 6 · #15647 §2 item 1 (rider) — quote, never paraphrase (`SKILL.md`)

Added after 526 (the 「派发词只带增量」 pointer) in the dispatch-brief rules:

```text
- 派发词引卡片的精确断言(schema 臂、判据、原文)一律逐字,⛔ 不释义转述。
```

Paid by folding 524 + 525 (`- 派发词 ⛔ 默认不整段粘贴 issue 正文:让 dev 自己读 GitHub 全文与全部评论。` / `- 派发词必须要求 dev 自查正文完整性。`) — one rule, as core-rules.md line 114 already digests them — into `- 派发词 ⛔ 默认不整段粘贴 issue 正文:让 dev 自己读全文与全部评论并自查正文完整性。`

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**为什么**:五条都是您在决裁批 #62 / #65 答「同意」的裁决,本 PR 只是把裁决落到文本。
